notes: Deterministic playbooks. No LLM by default. Triggered by application status + elapsed days. Each playbook has a short header, a checklist, and one next action.

no_response.header: No reply yet. Normal at day 7+.
no_response.microcopy: Most recruiters triage in batches. One short nudge beats silence.
checklist: Find the hiring manager or recruiter on LinkedIn.
Send a 3-line note: role, one proof artifact you produced for this job, one question.
Do not reapply through the portal.
Log one more milestone so your CV strengthens if they do reply.

rejection.microcopy: Readiness and missing primary skills usually tell you what happened.
checklist: Check which primary skills you had no proof for.
Pick one of them as a target skill on a similar tracked job.
Ask for 1-line feedback if a human replied. Keep it short.
Do not re-send the same CV to the same company within 90 days.

interview.header: Interview scheduled. Prep is proof, not trivia.
interview.microcopy: Walk in with artifacts tied to this job's target skills.
checklist: Re-read the job description. Mark the 3 skills they will test hardest.
Pull your completed milestone proofs for those skills. Be ready to screen-share one.
Prepare two questions that reveal how they measure success in the role.
Write a 60-second answer to: 'Why this job, why now?'

offer.header: Offer. Slow down before you sign.
offer.microcopy: The next 48 hours decide comp, scope, and stress for the next year.
checklist: Get the offer in writing. Ask for total comp breakdown: base, variable, equity, sign-on.
Ask: what does success look like in 90 days and who defines it?
Compare against two benchmarks you trust.
Ask for 48 hours to respond. Do not accept same-day.

abandoned.microcopy: Free the slot. Redirect the energy to a warmer lead.
checklist: Move its target skills onto a tracked job that is still active.
Your readiness on that next job updates immediately.
